name: standing single leg concentration calf raise
description: A one-legged calf raise performed slowly with full focus. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
instructions: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
